findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed learning window is the score-time interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity label is present in the supplied observations.

Continuous contrast features over the observed support are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dx shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts; a constant rule is therefore not supported by these observed-node linear fits.

Several landmark_00 local contrast features have large-magnitude first and last rate z-scores of opposite sign (e.g. local_dy first_rate_z strongly negative and last_rate_z positive; local_cyy first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive), indicating rate changes within the observed window rather than a single constant rate.

Polynomial fits are not accepted for the inspected continuous trends and extrapolation is disallowed, so time-conditioned statements must remain within the observed support and cannot be extended beyond it.

hypotheses.falsifier: A constant rule matching the observed-node contrast values within the reported node RMSE across the window would falsify the need for time conditioning.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx/dy contrast values at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule over the observed window [0.0, 0.5] would track the observed sign changes in landmark_00 soft-mass and local displacement contrasts better than a constant rule, using only observed-node interpolation.

hypotheses.falsifier: A validated fit with no accepted sign change and consistent first/last rate sign would falsify the reversal claim.
hypotheses.observable: first_rate_z versus last_rate_z sign and magnitude for landmark_00 local features
hypotheses.statement: The observed within-window rate reversals in landmark_00 local contrasts reflect changing coordinate contrast structure rather than a single stable geometric descriptor.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The supplied observations are coordinate contrast and trend diagnostics only; they are not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.

Only six of 200 continuous_trends rows were read; other features and tables (branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects, turnover_accounting, lineage_support) were not inspected in this turn.
No temperature edit is proposed or permitted; temperatures are immutable fixed parameters.
